lines.text: Depending on whether an application is for issue of fresh passport or re-issue of passport, Passport Office shall decide whether Police Verification
is required for issuance of Passport to you. In most cases of issue of fresh passport, pre-police verification would be required, exception being
Government servants on submission of Identity Certificate' as per Annexure A', or minors whose parent(s) hold valid passport etc. The general
rules, regulations and procedures pertaining to issue of passports as stipulated in Passports Act and Passports Rule would apply. In most cases
of re-issue, depending on records available in the Passport Office system, police verification would not be required or only post police verification
would be required, exceptions being re-issue of passport in lieu of lost passport or complete change of name.
